name: The Salt Road
summary: A first draft of a historical novel about a salt trader crossing the Sahara in the fourteenth century.
targetReason: Writing and discussion with no code to run; the desktop app keeps the outline and notes at hand.
goal: Finish a complete first draft of about 80,000 words.
audience: Adult readers of literary historical fiction.
deliverables: Character sheets for the main cast
A complete first draft, one file per chapter
constraints: The author writes the manuscript; Claude helps with structure, research questions and feedback
Historical details are flagged for checking, never invented as fact
doneWhen: Every chapter in the outline has a draft
The draft reads end to end without missing scenes

files.purpose: Chapter-by-chapter outline: what happens and why it matters.
One section per main character: wants, fears, arc.
